company.name: Opentrons
company.shortDescription: Opentrons is a life science company that develops pipetting robot technology designed to automate experiments.
company.description: Opentrons is a developer of pipetting robot technology designed to automate experiments. Their technology is automated laboratory equipment that automates experiments by using the Python language, enabling scientific researchers to make the process faster and less tiresome.

productsAndServices.description: A modular laboratory liquid-handling robot for automating pipetting and experimental workflows, with interchangeable pipettes, a plate gripper, configurable deck, touchscreen control, and on-deck modules.
productsAndServices.name: Opentrons Flex

productsAndServices.description: An open-source liquid-handling robot for automating laboratory pipetting and sample-preparation protocols, including workflows in molecular biology, cell biology, and education.
productsAndServices.name: OT-2

productsAndServices.description: Application-specific laboratory automation configurations for workflows such as NGS, proteomics, nucleic acid extraction, PCR, protein purification, and walk-up pipetting.
productsAndServices.name: Opentrons Workstations

productsAndServices.description: A software ecosystem for designing, running, and customizing automated laboratory protocols through the Opentrons App, Protocol Designer, Protocol Library, Labware Library, Python API, and documentation.
productsAndServices.name: Opentrons Software and Protocol Tools

productsAndServices.description: An AI-assisted protocol development tool that converts natural-language workflow descriptions into laboratory automation code and supports simulation, verification, and deck-map editing.
productsAndServices.name: OpentronsAI

productsAndServices.description: Technical and operational services for Opentrons instruments, including customer support, protocol assistance, field service, warranty coverage, and related implementation help.
productsAndServices.name: Opentrons Instrument Services and Support

aiResearchSummary.text: Opentrons is engaged in developing systems and methods for pipette robots, including operations such as deck and pipette tip calibration, as described in 'Systems and methods for pipette robots.' The company also researches moveable stage assemblies for pipette systems, as detailed in 'Moveable stage for a pipette system.' Additionally, Opentrons is working on apparatuses for controlled release of labware and thermocycler seals, supporting automation in laboratory workflows.

insights.title: Hybrid therapeutic platform
